question: Who was the Chairperson of the National Planning Committee in 1938?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jawaharlal Nehru.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** History of centralized planning in India

 
• Rudimentary economic planning, deriving from the sovereign authority of the state, was first initiated in India in 1938 by Congress President Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose, Atul Tiwari, Jawaharlal Nehru** (****Chairperson) **who had been persuaded by Meghnad Saha to set up a National Planning Committee.
 
• The First Five-Year Plan was launched in 1951, focusing mainly on the development of the agricultural sector.
 
• Two subsequent Five-Year Plans were formulated before 1965 when there was a break because of the Indo-Pakistan conflict.
